reuse.why: Wraps the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend in one shared applyWeekendRule and routes all three weekend-handling paths (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) through it.

duplication.why: Removes the repeated skipWeekend ternaries at the call sites; only the 7-occurrence lookahead is written twice (OCCURRENCE_LOOKAHEAD in shared, a literal count * 7 in schedules/app.ts).

placement.why: The rule is in shared/schedules.ts beside the existing weekend helper; callers only pass their config.

scope.why: Focused, though it also renames the schedule data field weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode in parseRecurDate (a consistency cleanup the change relies on).

maintainability.why: One function owns 'skip, move or keep' and returns null for dropped days, but the unshared magic lookahead number is easy to get out of step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No caller calls the move helper directly any more; getDateWithSkippedWeekend is made private.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains apart from the lookahead constant.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts applyWeekendRule, used by getNextDate, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts.
